examples.name: Sample — a self-certification form built from grids
paragraphs: Part III prints two side-by-side asset grids sharing one header row (Type of Asset, (A) Cash Value*, (B) Annual Income), each rendered as its own table; Parts I, II and IV are field lines, and the description tables under Parts III and IV are empty pre-printed rows. Several empty value cells print only a $ — see Fill-Ins§10.4.4.
